# GCU ISA 4.0 Assembly Reference

## 1. About this document

Generate time: 2025-08-13 07:43:27.038264

Get binary release from the latest date of [http://swbuild.enflame.cn/llvm](http://swbuild.enflame.cn/llvm)

This document gives assembly opcode and operand mnemonics.

### 1.1. Registers

GRegs - Scalar General Register. Value [0, 31]. Types: [i8, i16, i32, i64, f16, bf16, f32].

OARegs - Vector Register. Value: [0, 767]. Types: [v512i8, v256i16, v128i32, v64i64, v256f16, v256bf16, v128f32].

DOARegs - Dual Vector Register. Value: [0, 383]. Types: [v1024i8, v512i16, v256i32, v128i64, v512f16, v512bf16, v256f32].

QOARegs - Dual Vector Register. Value: [0, 383]. Types: [v2048i8, v1024i16, v512i32, v256i64, v1024f16, v1024bf16, v512f32].

### 1.2. Immediate

GCUimmN - unsigned immediate value. Value: [0, 2^N).

GCUsimmN - signed immediate value. Value: [-2^(N-1), 2^(N-1)).

### 1.3. Memory Addressing

[base] - (general) register based addressing. Commonly this is described as MEM. Value range is same as GRegs.

[base, disp] - base (general) register with displacement immediate. Commonly this is described as MEMrix, where ‘x’ is the bit width of the signed immediate value.

### 1.4. Thread Address

[group, postinc] - group register (ta_gx, x value: [0, 3]) with post increment tar (immediate value: [0, 7]).

(Note: [ta_g0/1/2/3, 0] actually references the group base register. It is valid to use ta_g0/1/2/3 instead.)

[dual_group, postinc] - dual group register (ta_dgx, x value: [0, 1]) with post increment tar (immediate value: [0, 7]).

### 1.5. Registers’ use conventions (experimental; suggestions are still welcome.)

- r0 - hardwired as 0.
- r1 - historically reserved for mbx config. Do NOT use!!
- sp - stack pointer, alias of r2. Do NOT use name “r2” directly!!
- lr - link register, alias of r3. Do NOT use name “r3” directly!!
- r31 - is used as frame-pointer (not always needed).

|Calling Convention|Register Type|Caller Save|Callee Save|Parameter|Return|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|(Default)|GRegs|r0 - r15|r16 - r31|r4 - r11|r4 - r7|
